newsitem.title: USA: Brazil coffee freeze risk next week 20% - Cropcast.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee freeze risk next week 20% - Cropcast.

text.p: Weather forecaster Cropcast said Friday long-range guidance models showed the greatest threat of cold weather reaching Brazil's coffee belt will be toward the middle of next week, with the probability of a freeze set at 20 percent.

"The latest long-range model forecast guidance is now suggesting that the threat of freezing temperatures will be greatest during the middle of next week instead of the weekend," Cropcast said in its daily weather summery.
In its extended outlook, Cropcast said long range models showed an area of 1032 mb high pressure will build across far southern Brazil by early Wednesday of next week.

"Depending on the exact track of of this high pressure system some freezing temperatures will be possible on Wednesday morning, especially across across the far southern portions of the coffee belt," Cropcast said. "We are maintaining our 20 percent probability for a freeze at that time".

However, forecaster Weather Services Corp said in its daily update today that while somewhat cooler temperatures could reach Brazil's coffee belt during the second half of the week, a high pressure expected to build in Argentina next week is likely to pass well to the south of coffee growing areas.
